Delete your account

You can permanently delete your Finance Tracker account and all of its data here, or in the Android app under More → Delete account.

What gets deleted

  • Your account: username, password and password hint.
  • All of your data: stock transactions and cash balances, mutual funds and SIPs, real estate, loans, other investments, monthly expenses, FIRE calculator inputs and settings.

Deletion is immediate and permanent — it cannot be undone. Server request logs (which contain IP addresses, not your financial data) are discarded after a limited period. If you want a copy of your data first, sign in on the website and use Export Excel.

Delete account

Forgot your password? Reset it from the sign-in page, or email support@mypgmanager.com from the address you want to be contacted at, with your username, and we will verify and delete the account.
